name: Assets and Silhouettes live in the game project folder and compile into the game

comments.text: From Dean (2026-11-19): a game made with the engine keeps all its assets, Silhouettes and material Silhouettes in the game project folder, which the editor and engine connect to for the scene. A built game compiles what it needs into objects with the binary; the Calamus files stay with the project, not the binary. Materials now follow this through generated Nyx (D-213). Left: move assets/ into the game project, and bake placed Silhouettes (scenes) the same way.
